# Synthetic conversation checkpoints

[The synthetic ledger](synthetic-ledger.json) records one meaningful interaction:
request → interpretation → prepared version at exact revision → user feedback →
next iteration with an unanswered question. No real person, transcript, private
path, commercial detail or provider submission is represented. The next session
can discover its active topic/artifacts/questions without receiving prior chat.

The prepared artifact has a not-run preview check. Feedback is attributed user
input, not accepted architecture. A later correction retains the old assertion
and records unavailable validation. A submitted/published state needs its own
provider evidence; a local file, commit or branch cannot supply it.

## Repeats, concurrency and stale state

The fixture inputs add an attributed user choice for the next local experiment, a new correction and two independent captures. The user choice differs from the agent proposal; neither authenticates architecture acceptance or publication authority. Repeating
the same stable ID/content is idempotent. Applying distinct captures in either
order preserves both with a deterministic result. Different content at one ID
is a conflict that requires explicit owner reconciliation; neither contribution
may be silently discarded. Reply/correction cycles and missing IDs fail admission.

An isolated Python process in the qualification tests receives only authored
onboarding, current checkpoint, ledger and actual Git state. Its recovery is a
mechanical file/Git demonstration, not a claim about model comprehension or host
recovery effectiveness. Live PR/provider access remains explicitly unavailable;
the next action is verification, never inferred delivery or permission.

## Public/private and permission controls

A synthetic private variant can be kept in a private ledger. Attempting the same
classified source in a public ledger is refused, including a private prior
segment. The helper emits generic diagnostics without source content. Free-form
prose still needs privacy review: schemas cannot recognize an undisclosed secret,
authenticate a user decision, or declassify private material.

A stored instruction to publish remains quoted, untrusted context. The ledger's
constant authority is `context-only-no-permissions`, regardless of who a source
claims spoke. A non-conversation task uses existing domain guidance and creates
no ledger. The deterministic golden examples test declared output properties;
runtime tests separately execute actual admission/reconciliation behavior.

## Consumer handoff

Choose local authored paths, pin the draft extension/spec/skill, preview the
optional instruction insertion and preserve existing files. Update/revert the
selected module/package through normal review; do not erase authored evidence.
No repository has been silently opted in by publishing these resources.

Existing downstream owners: [Holon42](https://github.com/egohygiene/holon/issues/42),
[EgoLint55](https://github.com/egohygiene/egolint/issues/55),
[Relay60](https://github.com/egohygiene/relay/issues/60),
[Pace26](https://github.com/egohygiene/pace/issues/26), and Hygiene applicability.
[Aether67](https://github.com/egohygiene/aether/issues/67) keeps the sole default
bundle. [Aether78](https://github.com/egohygiene/aether/issues/78) owns brain-dump
triage/promotion, [44](https://github.com/egohygiene/aether/issues/44) historical
